steps.title: Collect Slime Mold Specimens
steps.instruction: Collect slime mold specimens following Continental MycoBlitz or MycoMap Network protocols.

substeps.instruction: Photograph the specimen and upload images and metadata to iNaturalist.
Dry the specimen using a dehydrator at under 140F.
Print a label for the specimen and place it in a snack-size Ziplock bag.
For small specimens or those that turn to dust, collect them into a small tube or using a toothpick.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Extraction Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 8-strip PCR tubes for DNA extraction using ENA (Extract-N-Amp equivalent) solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of ENA to each 8-strip PCR tube.
Toothpick or tweeze spores/tissue into the tubes; for spore-heavy specimens, swirl the toothpick in the ENA.

steps.title: Perform Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the samples using stainless steel beads.

substeps.instruction: Use tweezers to add one 1mm stainless steel bead to each sample tube.
Beat the samples for 00:05:00 using a BioSpec Mini-Beadbeater-96 or an equivalent beadbeating methodology.

steps.title: Incubate and Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Heat the samples to release DNA and stabilize the extract.

substeps.instruction: Heat the tubes at 80C for 10 minutes in a thermocycler.
Add 50 µL of Low TE to the extract.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Set up PCR reactions using the LifePool barcoding system, utilizing an Opentrons OT2 liquid handling robot for dual-index primer plates.

substeps.instruction: Use the specified LifePool primers: 3 forward (GGTYGATCCTGYCAG, AATCTGCGAACGGCTCCGTA, TCTCTCTGAATCTGCGWAC) and 8 reverse (GGGGTTTAAAGGTCCCC, CRAACYCTDATCCTCTGT, CGAACTCTGATTCCCCGT, CGCGCCTGCTGCCTTCC, TGCTGGCACCAGACTTGT, GACTTGTCCTCYAATTGTTAC, GTCCTCTAATTGTTACTCGAD, ATCTCTCAGGCCCACTCTCCAGG).
Ensure each sample has 11 primers (all 3 forward and all 8 reverse) to create a unique tag combination.
For a 12.5uL 'half' PCR reaction, add 0.5uL of template to each cell.
Record specimen information and track sample numbers to individual wells on the Slime Empty NANOPORE TEMPLATE.xlsx spreadsheet.

steps.title: Post-PCR Processing and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Complete the workflow following the ONT DNA Barcoding Fungal Amplicons w/ MinION & Flongle protocol.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Perform data analysis using Specimux and Speconsense to accommodate permutational demultiplexing and consensus building for primer pools.
